description: A blurred, offset shadow at device pixel ratio 2: the offsets and the blur scale with the display.

florui.css: .scene { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 70px; background-color: #f4e9d8; } .t { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 10px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: #1b1b2f; text-shadow: 3px 3px 4px rgba(193, 68, 14, 0.8); }

classification.reason: Chromium and this engine draw the same font's glyphs with different rasterizers (the existing text fixtures are tolerant for that reason), so the glyph edges differ slightly in both the text and its shadow. Measured against desktop Chrome; geometry an exact match.
